HOME RENOVATION BUDGET TRACKER — USER GUIDE
Welcome! This spreadsheet helps you track every dollar of your renovation — from initial bids to final payments.

column2: Action
Enter your Total Budget (Dashboard Tab)
column3: Click Dashboard tab. Find yellow cell next to 'Total Original Budget'. Type your total budget (e.g. 150000 for $150,000). Press Enter. All other budget calculations update automatically. Do NOT change any other Dashboard cells.

column2: Set Up Scope & Budget by Room
column3: Click 'Scope & Budget by Room' tab. For each room or area, enter the Original Bid amount in column C (yellow cells). Leave columns D E F G H alone — they contain formulas that calculate automatically. Column D (Approved COs) pulls from Change Order Log. Column E (Revised Total) = Original Bid + Approved COs. Column F (Amount Paid) pulls from Payment Schedule. Column H (Status) will show: On Budget / Watch / Over Budget.

column2: Log Every Change Order (Change Order Log Tab)
column3: IMPORTANT: Log EVERY change order no matter how small. Scope creep kills renovation budgets. Fill in: Date, Room/Area, Description, Requested By, Reason, and Cost Impact. In column G type Y (approved) or N (not approved). Column H (Running Total) updates automatically. Red warning fires if approved COs exceed 10% of original budget. Room/Area names MUST match the Scope & Budget tab exactly.

column2: Track Payments (Payment Schedule Tab)
column3: Add a row for every milestone payment agreed with contractors. Fill in: Contractor/Vendor, Room/Area, Milestone Description, Scheduled Date, and Amount Due. When you make a payment enter Date Paid and Amount Paid. Column H (Outstanding Balance) calculates automatically. Rows highlighted RED = overdue (date passed, no payment recorded). Room/Area must match Scope & Budget tab exactly.

column2: Track Materials (Materials Tracker Tab)
column3: Log every material order: Item, Room/Area, Supplier, Budgeted Cost, and Actual Cost. Column F (Variance) = Actual minus Budgeted. Negative = savings. Positive = overage (highlighted red). Enter Order Date and Lead Time (Days) to track delivery timelines. Use Status column: Pending / Ordered / Delivered. Review weekly to catch delayed deliveries.
